welcome: Welcome to Vertex, your document-aware AI assistant. I've uploaded the PEHAM student handbook, and now I'll show you how Vertex answers questions with cited sources.
answer: I asked: when are office hours? Vertex pulled the answer straight from the handbook and cited the exact source chunks it used, so every claim can be verified.
citation: Clicking any citation jumps you to the source snippet in the document, so you can check the answer against the original text in one click.
weather: Vertex also has built-in tool calling. When I ask about the weather in Islamabad, it calls the Open-Meteo API live and returns a real forecast — not a made-up one.
